amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this payment, in the smallest currency unit.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.

payment_method.description: A payment source to be charged. This can be the ID of a card, a bank account, a source, a token, or a Customer.

receipt_email.description: The email address to which this charge's receipt will be sent.

description.description: An arbitrary string which you can attach to a `Charge` object.

statement_descriptor.description: Text that appears on the customer's statement as the statement descriptor for a non-card charge.

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this payment.

amount_authorized.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit that was authorized.

amount_refunded.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit refunded.

captured.description: If the charge was created without capturing, this Boolean means whether it is still uncaptured or has since been captured.

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.

customer.description: ID of the customer this charge is for if one exists.

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object.

paid.description: `true` if the charge succeeded, or was successfully authorized for later capture.

payment_method.description: ID of the payment method used in this charge.

receipt_email.description: This is the email address that the receipt for this charge was sent to.

refunded.description: Whether the charge has been fully refunded.

source_transfer.description: The transfer which created this charge.
